questions.question: After Shechem came to love Dinah, Jacob's daughter, what did he tell his father Hamor?

answers.text: Get me this girl as a wife
Send her back to her father

questions.question: Jacob's sons told Shechem and his father Hamor they would agree to a marriage only if who was circumcised?
Three days after the men of Shechem's city were circumcised, which two sons of Jacob attacked the city with swords?
When Jacob scolded Simeon and Levi for the trouble their attack caused, how did they answer him?

answers.text: They said Shechem had wronged their sister
They said they were sorry for the trouble
They promised to make peace with the land
